steps.caption: Open Ask AI, then the Notes tab.
Speak notes uses your microphone; here we paste them.
Paste what was said on the call.
Link it to the requirement it's about (opened from the requirement, the ID is filled in).
'Left unknown' lists what it would not guess.
Each change shows old → new value and the exact words it came from.
'Needs approval' — critical values like area, budget and dates also go to Review.
Untick what's wrong. Here we keep the area at 25,000 for now.
Tasks: your promises from the call. Unclear dates are flagged — which Friday?
Press Approve selected. Unticked items are discarded; nothing is sent to anyone.
Tasks are saved now; record changes wait in Review.
Open Review to finish the record changes.
